method.championships: 30 * sqrt(titles / 4), capped at 30; 4 is current verified leader. Rebaseline only on a published scoring-version update.
method.playoffs: 20 * [0.50*(playoff wins / playoff games) + 0.30*(finals appearances / seasons eligible) + 0.20*(playoff berths / seasons eligible)] when complete league-wide bracket evidence exists.
method.regular_season: 20 * regular-season win percentage, after season scope and total games are verified consistently.
method.all_play: 15 * league-wide all-play win percentage, season-balanced, from complete manager-weeks.
method.peaks: 10 * 0.70*(best completed-season regular-season win-percentage percentile) + 0.30*(verified records top-tier indicator). Requires full seasonal data and uniform benchmark.
method.longevity: 5 * min(seasons played / 10, 1); eligible season needs at least one verified official matchup.
method.missing: Do not impute missing component as zero; official ranking withheld until comparable data coverage.
method.2026: 2026 incomplete and excluded from all completed-season historical measurements until concluded.
method.legacy: 2016–2019 ESPN championship outcomes included; weekly performance and all-play excluded unless reconstructed with verified evidence.
